chapter: Dancers, Newton, Chu Berry and the Cab Calloway band
title: Newton session titles and the cassette
summary: Kirchner reads titles; Cole can't recall details until he hears them.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: That's true. Let's see what else we've got here on these sessions. 'I Found a New Baby,' 'The Brittwood Stomp,' otherwise known as 'I'm a Ding Dong Daddy.'

Right. 'There's No Two Ways About It,' and 'Cause My Baby Says It's So.' And then in '39 you did 'Rosetta,' 'Minor Jive,' 'The World Is Waiting for the Sunrise,' 'Who,' 'The Blues My Baby Gave to Me' and 'Rompin'. Any of those ring a bell?
Ring a bell, yeah, but I just can't go into detail about them too much because I sort of forgot them until I hear the record.
Do you have a cassette player?
Do I have a cassette, yeah.
I'll leave the cassette with you tonight if you want to play something.
